predictedBugs: A Pub/Sub notification could be treated as mailbox truth; ingress now stores hash-only wake-up evidence and the worker always reconciles through bounded Gmail history.
A Gmail watch could expire silently; the cron worker schedules lease/fence renewal jobs and rotates watch plus immutable ingress routing with CAS.
An ambiguous Gmail send could be resent or rely on an unauthorized q query; it now fails closed and performs only a bounded no-q metadata scan when that separate scope is active.
A completed or archived task could leave an active provider event; explicit complete, cancel and delete operations are bound to the current task version and Omnix-owned event.
A CLI probe could claim health without a provider request; it now verifies OIDC identity and optional Gmail profile, refreshing the access token with owner-bound CAS when required.
edgeCases: Expired history cursors enter full_resync_required and recover with one bounded 100-message scan before resuming history.list.
Duplicate and out-of-order push deliveries coalesce by generation and cannot duplicate contact activity.
Scope or account drift rejects worker/probe authority before an external write or successful receipt.

skipWarning: Google production credentials, OAuth verification/assessment, Pub/Sub IAM, real-account UAT and browser accessibility evidence are not available in this workspace.
